title: Reflective Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2406.03678v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-policy reinforcement learning methods, like Trust Region Policy Optimization (TRPO) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), often demand extensive data per update, leading to sample inefficiency. This paper introduces Reflective Policy Optimization (RPO), a novel on-policy extension that amalgamates past and future state-action information for policy optimization. This approach empowers the agent for introspection, allowing modifications to its actions within the current state. Theoretical analysis confirms that policy performance is monotonically improved and contracts the solution space, consequently expediting the convergence procedure. Empirical results demonstrate RPO's feasibility and efficacy in two reinforcement learning benchmarks, culminating in superior sample efficiency. The source code of this work is available at https://github.com/Edgargan/RPO.

translated_abstract: 同策略强化学习方法，如信任区域策略优化（TRPO）和近端策略优化（PPO），通常每次更新都需要大量数据，导致样本效率低下。本文提出了反思策略优化（Reflective Policy Optimization, RPO），这是一种新颖的同策略扩展方法，它融合了过去和未来的状态-动作信息用于策略优化。这种方法使智能体能够进行自我反思，允许其在当前状态下修改自己的动作。理论分析证实，策略性能得到单调提升，并且解空间被收缩，从而加快了收敛过程。实验结果证明了RPO在两个强化学习基准测试中的可行性和有效性，最终展现出卓越的样本效率。本工作的源代码可在 https://github.com/Edgargan/RPO 获取。
tldr: 本文提出反思策略优化（RPO），一种新颖的同策略强化学习扩展方法，通过融合过去和未来的状态-动作信息使智能体能够自我反思并修改当前动作，实现策略性能的单调提升、解空间收缩和更快的收敛速度，显著提高了样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Reflective Policy Optimization (RPO), a novel on-policy reinforcement learning extension that enables agents to introspect and modify their actions by amalgamating past and future state-action information, achieving monotonic policy improvement, a contracted solution space, faster convergence, and superior sample efficiency.
